acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: Linndale, Ohio, is a town known almost entirely for its speed trap. Producer Sean Cole explains.
acts.title: The Most Expected Delay in Northern Ohio

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Traffic jams that last days are not uncommon in China. Producer Stephanie Foo talks to two people about how they pass the time.
acts.title: Asleep at the Wheel

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: New York City has a paratransit service called Access-a-Ride for passengers who are disabled and elderly. But people who rely on the system refer to it as Stress-a-Ride. We hear from Britney Wilson, who uses the service every day. A version of Britney’s story first appeared on Longreads.
acts.title: The Longest Distance Between Two Points
